method: Live official ScienceDirect homepage and complete author guide in the in-app browser; web retrieval returned 403 so normal browser was used.

minimum_mandatory_cost.basis: Homepage explicitly states no publication fee charged to authors. Author guide lists no additional mandatory page, submission, overlength or color charge for this route.
minimum_mandatory_cost.conditions: Do not elect optional open access or paid print services; reconfirm any final publisher invoice before author commitment.

limits.highlights: Required separate editable file, 3-5 bullets, each at most85characters including spaces
limits.graphical_abstract: Required separate file, at least531h by1328w pixels or proportionally larger, readable at5 by13cm; TIFF/EPS/PDF/MSOffice accepted
limits.main_text: No fixed main-word or display-item cap identified
limits.references: Consistent complete style accepted for initial submission; 30-50 typical rather than minimum

layout: Editable single-column Word; double spacing,3cm margins, consecutive page numbers; numbered main sections, unnumbered abstract; editable tables with no vertical rules or shading; tables/legends on separate pages at end; separate figure source files. Single-anonymized review.
declarations: Truthful affiliation and postal address; CRediT, funding and interests; AI declaration before references. Data/code availability follows OptionC. Do not invent personal information or contributions.
graphics: Code/data-derived explanatory schematic may be used. If generativeAI assistance is actually used, disclose it in caption and general declaration; never fabricate observed/experimental imagery.
preprints: Allowed; no journal-specific restriction on revising an existing preprint identified. Accurately identify existing Qeios version and review status.
scope_limit: These are eligibility and formatting checks, not an acceptance prediction.
